text: Cross-client: deleting an item is confirmed and undoable on Android, immediate on web

Landed in f63d38f. The web's item delete now confirms, reusing Android's existing item_delete_title/item_delete_body word for word. No undo was added: Android has none on this surface either (its undo is on the registry's own row-icon delete, which the web has no equivalent of). I resolved the cherry-pick conflict here myself — the web agent's error-surfacing delete and this confirmation were edits to the same handler, so the merged version confirms first and then reports a failed push.
